text: また　あそびに　いきたいな！

structure.jp: あそびに　いきたいな！
structure.en: I want to go and play!

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: あそびに　いきたい
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a going or coming verb says what you go there to do. あそびに いきたい = 'want to go to play'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says the speaker wants to do it. いきたい = 'I want to go'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker's own feeling, here a wish said half to himself. いきたいな = 'I'd sure like to go'.
